semantics.clock: Update only at positive edge of clk; inputs sampled at that edge
semantics.reset: Synchronous active-low reset; resetn=0 clears all 16 bits to zero at a positive edge, overriding byteena
semantics.enabled_update: With resetn=1, byteena[0] writes d[7:0] to q[7:0], and byteena[1] writes d[15:8] to q[15:8] independently
semantics.disabled_update: Each disabled byte retains its preceding value
semantics.between_edges: q holds, including when resetn changes without a positive clock edge
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up value; no initialization added. Tests establish state using synchronous reset
semantics.latency: Sampled input appears in q immediately following the same positive edge, after sequential update

numeric.arithmetic: None; exact bit copying or retaining

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit reference: reset clears each bit, otherwise copy d bit when byteena[bit_index/8] is high
verification.directed: All four byteena combinations, full-width patterns, each one-hot input bit, reset overriding every enable combination, repeated reset, hold cycles
verification.timing: Check q holds after input changes and falling edges; assert and deassert reset between rising edges and check synchronous behavior
verification.random: Deterministic pseudo-random input, byte-enable and reset sequences with per-bit scoreboard
verification.execution: Icarus SystemVerilog -g2012 with explicit dev_tb top, finite compile and simulation timeouts, fatal mismatch and final PASS

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset value not explicitly stated in prose
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret reset of D flip-flops as clearing all q bits to zero.
